description: This file defines the MigrationHubOrchestratorClient class, which extends AwsClient and serves as a client interface for interacting with the AWS Migration Hub Orchestrator service. It declares methods for various operations related to templates, workflows, steps, and tags, both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: MigrationHubOrchestratorClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Migration Hub Orchestrator service, providing methods for managing templates, workflows, steps, and related resources.
